hero.line1: Save any page in one click.
hero.sub: Cloudmark is a cloud bookmark collection. Pick a name, drag the save button to your bookmarks bar, and from then on any page worth keeping is one click away — on your phone, your laptop, any browser, by link alone.

save.title: One-click save
save.desc: The save button lives in your bookmarks bar. When a page is worth keeping, click it once: title, URL and icon are filed away without interrupting what you are reading. That is all the product ever asks of you.

categorize.title: Tidy categories
categorize.desc: Give bookmarks a category and long lists stay legible. Search, filter and sort happen on one screen; the number keys 1 through 9 switch categories like turning to a chapter in a bound index.

access.title: Open anywhere
access.desc: A collection is a link. Send it to yourself, to a colleague; open it on a phone or on someone else’s machine and it is simply there. Reading needs no credentials — only writing does.

security.title: Read by link, write by token.
security.note: With no accounts there are no passwords to lose. Each collection carries one write token: anyone with the link may browse, only the token holder may change things. The token lives in your browser and your save button; the server keeps only its hash — even we cannot read it back.

close.title: Create your collection
close.sub: Pick a name — it becomes your link. Install the save button, add a first bookmark, and the collection is yours.

NotFoundPage.title: Page not found
NotFoundPage.description: The page does not exist, or the collection name was mistyped. Check the spelling of the link, or start again from the home page.

DocPage.title: Four steps to your collection.
DocPage.description: No account, no email. Pick a name, back up one token, drag two buttons — everything after that is a single click.

name.desc: The name (mark) becomes your link. Use a meaningful phrase — easy to remember, easy to share — or roll a random one.

token.desc: The token is generated on this machine; the server keeps only its hash and cannot recover it. Copy or download it before you continue.
token.warn: Anyone holding this token can change your collection. Never share it publicly.
token.hint: Back it up before continuing. The token is created on this device — the server cannot recover it.
token.mustBackup: Copy or download a backup before continuing

settings.desc: Collections are public by default: the link is enough to read. A private collection requires the token even to view.
